name: Jaguar
role: Apex predator — keeps prey populations (capybara, frog) in balance.
funFact: Jaguars have the strongest bite force of any big cat relative to their size, capable of piercing turtle shells.

name: Crocodile
role: Apex predator in rivers and wetlands; ambushes prey near water.
funFact: Crocodiles can slow their heart rate to as low as 2-3 beats per minute while submerged.

name: Capybara
role: Grazer that helps control vegetation growth near water sources.
funFact: Capybaras are the largest rodents in the world and are highly social, living in groups of 10-20.

name: Rainforest Frog
role: Controls insect populations; sensitive indicator of ecosystem health.
funFact: Many rainforest frogs absorb water and oxygen directly through their skin.

name: Hummingbird (Colibrí)
role: Vital pollinator for flowering plants like banana trees.
funFact: Hummingbirds can beat their wings up to 80 times per second and are the only birds that can fly backwards.

name: Banana Tree
role: Food source for herbivores and pollinators; provides canopy structure.
funFact: The banana 'tree' is technically not a tree at all — it's the world's largest herbaceous flowering plant.

name: Jungle Tree
role: Forms the rainforest canopy, providing oxygen, shelter, and food.
funFact: A single rainforest tree can host hundreds of insect species in its canopy alone.
